newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday, with low sulphur fuel oil easier and gas oil steady, trader said.
Gasoline and naphtha continued to be driven by U.S. demand which was supporting prices. European demand, however was thin for both products.
Low sulphur fuel oil fell by around $5 a tonne on poor Italian demand and good supply.
Gas oil was steady. Strong German heating oil demand and French low sulphur diesel buying interest supported premiums.
